events.description: Called when the user presses Save; a returned promise keeps the button busy until it settles.
events.name: onSave

events.description: Called when the user presses Discard; the app restores the saved values.
events.name: onDiscard

props.description: True while the form has unsaved changes; the bar slides in then and out once it is false again.
props.name: isDirty

props.description: True while a save runs that the bar did not start (a form library's submit); Save shows busy.
props.name: isSaving

props.description: True to refuse Save, for example while the form is invalid; Discard stays available.
props.name: isSaveDisabled

props.description:
Change it to call the user's eye to the bar: it shakes (and plays a warning haptic on native), for example when
LeaveConfirmation blocked a navigation while the form was dirty. Reduced motion skips the shake.
props.name: attentionKey

props.description: The message, for example "Unsaved product changes". Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "Unsaved changes".
props.name: message

props.description: The text of the save button. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "Save".
props.name: saveLabel

props.description: The text of the discard button. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "Discard".
props.name: discardLabel

props.description: The spoken name of the bar. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "Unsaved changes".
props.name: label

props.description: Extra content between the message and the buttons, usually a `SaveStatus`.
props.name: children

props.description: Where the autosave is; `idle` draws nothing.
props.name: state

props.description: The text while saving. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "Saving".
props.name: savingLabel

props.description: The text once saved, for example "Saved at 14:05". Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "All changes saved".
props.name: savedLabel

props.description: The text when the save failed. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's "Couldn't save".
props.name: failedLabel
